name: Pseudo-Boolean Optimization Camouflage
description: Transforms local pairwise constraints into a single global quadratic pseudo-Boolean equation whose algebraic minimum corresponds exactly to the original problem's valid states. It defeats survivors by mimicking an NP-hard QUBO problem, forcing them to mathematically prove the non-negativity of the factored summand to discover the hidden P-time 2-coloring structure, rather than relying on the heuristic "input is pairs + local constraint = bipartite graph".
